subject: general
question:
Choose the correct word to complete the sentence.

The hikers were lost in a dense _____ of narrow lanes.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. maze**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"maze"** means a complex network of paths or passages that are difficult to navigate. (भूलभुलैया)

 
 
• **Example:** The hikers got lost in the maze of narrow streets in the old part of the city.
 
 
 
• The word **"dense"** refers to something closely compacted or crowded, which complements the idea of a "maze".
 
 
• **Example:** The dense forest was like a natural maze, making it hard to find the right path.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **maze (Option 2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Maize** (मकई): A type of grain, commonly known as corn, grown for food.

 
 
• **Example:** Maize is widely cultivated in many parts of the world as a staple crop.
 
 
 
• **Mess** (गड़बड़): A state of disorder or untidiness.
 
 
• **Example:** After the party, the room was in a complete mess.
 
 
 
• **Mass** (द्रव्यमान / समूह): A large body of matter or a large group of people or objects.
 
 
• **Example:** The mass of people gathered in the square to witness the celebration.
